contexts.text: To plant vineyards = the plantation of the Spiritual Church. Illustrated.
In each plant lies hidden the endeavour to produce fruits or seeds; but this endeavour does not manifest itself until it has first produced all the means; namely, the branches, leaves, and flowers...
Thou wilt plant them () = regeneration continually. To plant = to regenerate; for regeneration is circumstanced like plantation. Explained.
The Prolific in plants corresponds to the good in man...
As the Prolific in the seed produces a new tree, or a new plant.
To plant plants of delights () = such things as favour the affections.
In the First Heaven they see... flowers and plants, etc.
Mediates are... plants, etc.
Plants () = truths.
To plant them () = to receive them spiritually; that is, to understand them.
To plant a vine () = to instaurate the Spiritual Church.
Plantation () takes place in the interiors of man, where is the good of love and of charity; and growth, in the exteriors, where is the good of life.
To plant, etc. () = instruction according to order...
To plant vineyards = the implantation of truth and its reception.
Plants () = truths.
To Vie planted () = to be instaurated.
To plant a vineyard- () = to instaurate the Church.
To plant, and build () = to confirm themselves in evils and falsities, and to live in them.
By all things of the world, are meant plants, etc.
There is no tree, plant, etc., and nothing in a tree, plant, etc., which is not for use.
In the vegetable kingdom there are two universals; in one are the trees of fruit; and in the other are the plants of seeds...
By vegetable forms are meant... plants, etc.
3. 4. Whether it be a tree with its fruit, or a plant with its seed.
5. By vegetative souls are meant trees and plants of every kind.
